capabilities: Summarize the current note, selected text, or multiple notes
Generate structured knowledge cards from notes or selections
Chat with the current note and @-mention vault notes
Rewrite, expand, shorten, polish, or extract tags from selected text
Sync Markdown content bidirectionally with WiseMindAI and search both stores
extras: Desktop-only because it connects to a local WiseMindAI service; commands and settings are documented in both English and Simplified Chinese; the README ends with maintainer release instructions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use the WiseMindAI desktop app's summarization, card generation, chat, and sync features on vault notes.

relations.evidence: WiseMindAI for Obsidian connects your Obsidian vault with the WiseMindAI desktop app.

requires.name: WiseMindAI desktop app with local API enabled

summary: WiseMindAI integration that summarizes notes, generates knowledge cards, chats with note content, rewrites text, and syncs Markdown with the WiseMindAI desktop app.
